idea:
for the design of the control panel (DCU),
i want one centered pair one above the other, 
a little green led display screen that at rest displays all knob information in a small condensed format, 
and a rotation knob that controls: AC temp, fan speed, fan mode, 
when being controlled adjusts the screen to display only the current adjustment area.
by default it will adjust temp, if you press the knob in once it will then adjust fan speed until you don't adjust for a moment
bellow the screen there will be 2 small buttons on either side of the control knob:
the top driver side will be fan modes, which will tell the center knob to now adjust the fan mode not temp also only until you stop adjusting
the top passenger side will simply toggle reeducate air or not.
bottom driver side will enable the read glass defog,
bottom passenger side will enable the side mirror defog
the knob should be cycled with green led light at the base that is just bright enough to illuminate the 4 buttons in the dark
the screen above will the the only indicator of the knobs left to right orientation (it should rotate freely forever both directions)
these 4 buttons will be back lit when they are enabled, dark (only illuminated from the center) when off. 
recirculate should default to off while dark pulling fresh air, and only recirculate when enabled and lit green
the AC condenser should automatically turn on if chosen temp is bellow outside temp, no special toggle needed
on either side of that center section should be each window control switch
small and simple for these is perfect again backlight with green led
then on either edge, one nob for the seat heat/cooling pushing the nob in toggle on or off
turning left makes it cooler (past half switches from heating to cooling)
cooling is default so in nob is pressed on but not turned left or right then it should turn on lowest fan speed cooling seats.
these dials must have some small light way of indicating they are on, and wether they are cooling or heating, and the effort spent on the heating cooling
i want to play around with all of this nothing is set in stone, can you save all this information, ask me about anything i missed,
then make a rudimentary visual depiction of what this would look like so we can perfect it
